apps.versionDescription: v1.5.9 — Raga detail: the scale is now two Varisai-style swara group rows (one group per direction, each swara its own cell, the shared SwaraTokenCell from DesignSystem), and the playing swara highlights during playback in sync with the piano. Carries v1.5.8 (Listen card cleanup) and v1.5.7 (editor as modal cover in both studios).
